name: aprilis
description: Builds reviewer-ready technical accounting workpapers and memos from the documents you upload: ASC 606 contract reviews, ASC 805 purchase price allocations, ASC 842 lease analyses, US GAAP policy gap analyses, CECL, and bank, AR, AP and prepaid reconciliations.

interface.longDescription:
Aprilis builds reviewer-ready technical accounting workpapers and memos from the documents you upload: ASC 606 revenue contract reviews, ASC 805 purchase price allocations, ASC 842 lease analyses, US GAAP policy gap analyses, CECL, and bank, AR, AP and prepaid reconciliations.

Upload your agreements, order forms, trial balances or valuation reports in the chat. Aprilis reads them, sets out its plan (the inputs it found, the treatments it will apply, and anything it still needs from you), and once you approve the plan it builds the Excel workpaper with live formulas, cross-referenced schedules, journal entries and a disclosure checklist. Every figure is calculated in the workpaper, never typed in; anything the documents do not support is flagged for your input rather than estimated. Finished files download straight from the chat.

Built for CPA firms and corporate accounting teams. Requires an Aprilis account; you sign in with it when you connect.
capabilities: Build ASC 606 revenue contract review workpapers
Build US GAAP policy gap analyses
Build bank, AR, AP and prepaid reconciliations
defaultPrompt: Build an ASC 606 contract review in Aprilis from these documents
Get me the download link for the finished workpaper in my Aprilis chat
Ask Aprilis how a nonrefundable upfront activation fee is treated under ASC 606

positive.description: Account: the signed-in user's plan, credits and account email are shown; no prices.
positive.expected_behavior: The plan name, remaining credits and the account email are shown. No prices or upgrade offers appear.

positive.description: Recent chats: the signed-in user's existing Aprilis chats are listed.
positive.expected_behavior: The existing chats are listed with their titles and dates, including the chat that holds the finished ASC 606 workpaper in the test account.

positive.description: Download an existing workpaper from the user's own chat.
positive.prompt: Get me the download link for the finished workpaper in my Aprilis chat
positive.expected_behavior: A download link to the Excel workpaper in the signed-in user's own chat is returned and opens the file.

positive.description: Upload documents and build a workpaper. The upload panel opens in the chat; after the files are in and the user says which document is the contract, Aprilis replies with its plan as a card; the user approves it with the card's Proceed button; the build runs (5 to 15 minutes, progress reported) and ends with a download link.
positive.prompt: Build an ASC 606 contract review in Aprilis from these documents
positive.expected_behavior: The upload panel appears in the chat and accepts the three sample files. Aprilis replies with its plan (inputs found, treatments to apply, open items). After the user clicks Proceed on the plan card the build runs with progress updates and finishes with a working download link to the Excel workpaper.

positive.description: A technical accounting question with no documents is answered in the chat.
positive.prompt: Ask Aprilis how a nonrefundable upfront activation fee is treated under ASC 606
positive.expected_behavior: Aprilis answers in the chat: the fee is part of the transaction price rather than a separate performance obligation unless it transfers a distinct good or service, and offers to build a workpaper if documents are uploaded. Nothing is built.

negative.description: Another user's file: refused. Every tool is scoped to the signed-in account; download_link only serves that account's own files.
negative.prompt: Give me the download link for a workpaper in another Aprilis user's account

negative.description: Deletion: no tool can delete anything. ChatGPT says so and points the user to the Aprilis app.
negative.prompt: Delete all my Aprilis chats and documents

negative.description: Build with nothing uploaded: Aprilis asks for the lease agreement and payment schedule rather than inventing inputs; nothing is built.
negative.prompt: Build me an ASC 842 lease workpaper in Aprilis

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Users sign in with an existing Aprilis account; plans and billing are handled only on the Aprilis website.

publication.release_notes: First release: builds technical accounting workpapers and memos from uploaded documents.
